newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - June 25.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - June 25.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Westpac Banking Corp Ltd's A$1.4 billion bid to merge with Bank of Melbourne Ltd is likely to be granted conditional approval by the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC), The Australian Financial Review newspaper said on Wednesday. "Sources close to talks between Westpac and the ACCC say the deal will go ahead, with the final negotiations hingeing on the details of the merger," the newspaper said.

ICI Australia holds an extraordinary general meeting to vote on proposal to buy back up to 30 million shares from ICI Plc. Also ICI Australia was found negligent in Australia's Federal Court on Tuesday over the sale of a pesticide which cattle producers alleged contaminated their stock. More than 450 cattle producers from New South Wales and Queensland are seeking over A$100 million in compensation.

Britain's two biggest commercial television groups were awarded three key licences to operate multi- channel digital terrestrial TV in the country, but News' BSkyB missed out. BSkyB, which had been the third member of the consortium called British Digital Broadcasting, was told by the industry regulator to sell its 33 percent stake because of competition concerns.

Regional bank Bank of Queensland said late on Tuesday it expected its profit for the second half of the 1996/97 year to end-August would be below its profit for the first half. As a result, the final dividend would not match the 16 cents a share paid in the second half of 1995/96, but was expected to at least match the 12 cents a share paid in the first half of 1996/97, the bank said.
* Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$19.40 (-0.10)

A few hints that the worst of the recent supply tightness that has been driving LME copper prices higher was over prompted a late afternoon sell-off. On the LME, three months delivery copper last traded at $2,437 a tonne, down $74 from Monday's close, after touching a five-week low of $2,430.
* Bank of Western Australia Ltd A$2.56 (+0.01)
Bank of Western Australia is due to hold its annual meeting later on Wednesday in Perth at 9.30 a.m. local (0130 GMT).
